title: A report cannot cite a record that its own rewriting decision has not reached
why: A report cited decision ci-job-caps, last touched Oct 28, as if it held a later ruling (F119). Source: owner-feedback audit, claude-settings draft PR #1008 (docs/plans/owner-feedback-audit.md, section 6), Nov 1 20:06 CST.
note: Done on main da8d8073: via PR #1091 (batch 66c) (repo check by triage, Nov 3 17:02 CST). Earlier note: A report that cites a record goes red if the record's last main commit predates the decision that rewrites it. Red first: replay F119. Ready. Port: yes, shared.
